t.zh: 用逗号隔开的 which 从句叫：它补充说明一个已经确定的名词，不用来区分是哪一个。折法一样。
t.en: A which clause between commas is a : it adds something about a noun already pinned down, rather than saying which one. It folds the same way.

title.zh: Our model, which has seven billion parameters, runs on a single GPU.
title.en: Our model, which has seven billion parameters, runs on a single GPU.

body.zh: 主干 Our model runs；逗号里补充“它有七十亿参数”，on a single GPU 挂在 runs 上。我们的模型有七十亿参数，能在一块 GPU 上运行。
body.en: The skeleton is Our model runs; the commas add that it has seven billion parameters, and on a single GPU hangs on runs.

note.zh: 两个逗号夹着的从句，拿掉后主干完整。
note.en: Take out a clause between commas, and the skeleton stands whole.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

hint.zh: 把两个逗号之间的那一块拿掉，句子还剩什么？
hint.en: Take out what lies between the commas: what is left?

tasks.sentence: Our model, which has seven billion parameters, runs on a single GPU.

parameters.zh: 这一块在逗号外面，修饰不到从句里的 parameters：在一块 GPU 上运行的是模型。
parameters.en: It lies outside the commas and cannot reach parameters inside the clause: what runs on one GPU is the model.

has.zh: has 在逗号里的从句中。主干的谓语在第二个逗号后面。
has.en: has is inside the clause between the commas. The skeleton’s verb comes after the second comma.
